visual.general_description: Four-panel brain MRI figure (A to D) with axial slices on black backgrounds.
visual.detailed_description: Four axial grayscale brain MRI slices, each with a printed parenthesised panel letter at the upper left: (A) at the top left, (B) below it at the bottom left, (C) at the top right and (D) at the bottom right. Panel A shows bright ventricles on a darker brain, panel B shows dark ventricles, panel C shows two bright areas beside the central ventricular region, and panel D shows bright ventricles and a bright scalp rim. No arrows, circles, scale bars or side markers are drawn. A small partly cut-off yellow text overlay is visible at the lower edge of panel A only.

panels.general_description: Axial T2-weighted brain MRI slice in the upper left of the figure.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale axial brain slice on a black rectangular field, with the skull outline and dark-rimmed scalp around the brain. Fluid spaces at the centre, including both lateral ventricles and the midline region, are bright, and the surrounding brain tissue is darker grey with bright sulcal folds at the periphery. A small partly cut-off yellow text overlay sits at the lower edge of the black field below the slice. No arrows, circles or other markers are drawn on the brain. The printed panel label is "(A)" at the upper left.

visual.general_description: Grayscale angiographic projection of the cerebral vessels on a dark background.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale image on a black field showing bright, branching tubular vessels. A network of vessels converges in the centre, with a thin pair of vessels running upward from it to the top edge, thick curved vessels at the lower left and lower right running toward the bottom edge, and finer curling branches at the upper left and upper right. Faint grey soft-tissue contours of the head fill the area on both sides of the vessels. No printed panel letter, arrow, text label, side marker or scale is visible.
